title: Your Technology & Innovation Forum East Guide To Hudson Yards And Beyond
summary: Attending Technology & Innovation Forum East? Check out our guide to Hudson Yards for coffee, dining, shopping, relaxing, and networking with peers.
body_markdown:
[Technology & Innovation Forum East](https://www.forrester.com/event/technology-innovation-east/) brings together technology leaders, architects, strategists, and innovators to explore what’s next and turn emerging ideas into action. But where you are matters.


Held at[Convene 30 Hudson Yards](https://www.forrester.com/event/technology-innovation-east/venue/) , the Forum places you in the center of one of New York City’s most dynamic business districts. Surrounded by walkable attractions, standout dining, and iconic landmarks, Hudson Yards makes it easy to recharge, continue conversations, and make the most of your time outside the meeting rooms.


Here’s how to make the most of Hudson Yards while you’re at Technology & Innovation Forum East.


## Start The Day With A Fresh Perspective


Before sessions begin, take advantage of being in one of Manhattan’s most distinctive neighborhoods.


### The High Line


*An iconic New York walk above the city streets*


- **Time needed:** 30–60 minutes
- **Why it works:** Built on a former elevated rail line, the[High Line](https://www.thehighline.org/) combines city views, public art, and green space in a setting that feels removed from the busy streets below. It’s ideal for a quick walk or an early conversation with peers before the Forum begins.
- **Good to know:** Access points are just steps from Hudson Yards, making it one of the easiest ways to experience the neighborhood.


### Coffee Worth Walking For


*If you think best with caffeine in your system, you’ll find no shortage of options nearby.*


- [Blue Bottle Coffee](https://bluebottlecoffee.com/us/eng/cafes/hudson-yards?srsltid=AfmBOopl1ElG5ij1Ho1zDoLW5dRrwLkwuxYyRjYqQmJVyUpTYl6Nf9dX) (20 Hudson Yards, #228) — known for espresso drinks and single-origin coffees; ideal when you want a high-quality cup without straying far from the venue
- [Bluestone Lane](https://bluestonelane.com/coffee-shops/30-hudson-yards-lobby-500-w-33rd-st/) (55 Hudson Yards, next to Vessel) — Australian-inspired café culture with breakfast bowls and comfortable seating; a great choice for a relaxed start to the day
- [Madman Espresso](https://www.madmanespresso.com/) (311 11th Ave.) — a neighborhood favorite with strong coffee, hearty breakfast options, and an industrial-chic atmosphere that feels more local than corporate
- [Daily Provisions](https://www.dailyprovisions.co/) (440 West 33rd Street) — known for its crullers and breakfast sandwiches, making it a great stop when you need coffee and something substantial before a full day of sessions


## Got 15 Minutes?


[Technology & Innovation Forum East](https://www.forrester.com/event/technology-innovation-east/) packs a lot into two days. Sometimes the most productive thing you can do is step away for a few minutes and let ideas settle.


### Vessel


*An iconic stop just steps from the Forum*


[Vessel at 20 Hudson Yards](https://www.vesselnyc.com/) is the striking centerpiece of the Hudson Yards Public Square. Ticketed access is available for visitors who want to enter the structure, while the surrounding plaza is free to explore, making it an easy option for a quick break between sessions.


- **Stretch your legs:** Take a quick loop through the plaza and view one of Hudson Yards’ most recognizable landmarks.
- **Continue the conversation:** Step outside with a colleague to discuss a session takeaway away from the meeting rooms.
- **Recharge:** Find a seat, get some fresh air, and gather your thoughts before your next discussion.


Sometimes a short change of scenery is all it takes to turn information into insight.


## Extend The Best Conversations Over Dinner


Some of the most valuable Forum moments happen after the final session ends, when conversations move beyond presentations and into real-world experiences.


Fortunately, Hudson Yards makes it easy to continue the discussion without venturing far.


### Peak


*Skyline views and a memorable setting*


Located at 30 Hudson Yards,[Peak](https://taogroup.com/venues/peak-restaurant-new-york/) offers dramatic views of the city and a distinctive backdrop for executive dinners, client conversations, or team gatherings.


### Mercado Little Spain


*Flexible, lively, and group-friendly*


Located at 10 Hudson Yards,[Mercado Little Spain](https://www.littlespain.com/) brings together Spanish restaurants, food counters, bars, and market offerings under one roof, making it an easy choice for groups with different tastes and schedules.


### Cookshop


*A Chelsea favorite*


[Cookshop](https://www.cookshopny.com/) (156 10th Ave.), approximately a 15- to 20-minute walk from the venue, offers seasonal, locally sourced fare with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices in a relaxed setting.


## See A Little More Of New York


One advantage of[Technology & Innovation Forum East](https://www.forrester.com/event/technology-innovation-east/) is its location near some of New York City’s most recognizable destinations.


### Edge


*Big-picture thinking from above the city*


Located at 30 Hudson Yards,[Edge](https://www.edgenyc.com/) offers panoramic views of Manhattan, the Hudson River, and beyond. Situated more than 100 stories above the city, the observation deck features a glass floor, outdoor viewing areas, and sweeping 360-degree views of New York.


Whether you visit before the Forum begins or extend your stay after the Forum, it’s a memorable way to experience the city from a different perspective.


- **Time needed:** Allow 60–90 minutes, depending on ticket time and visitor volume
- **Best for:** First-time visitors, client outings, or taking in the scale and energy of New York


### Staying A Little Longer?


If you’re extending your trip, consider exploring arts and experiences at[the Shed](https://www.theshed.org/) next to Hudson Yards or continue south along Manhattan’s West Side to shopping and dining at[Chelsea Market](https://www.chelseamarket.com/) , explore the urban oasis of[Little Island](https://littleisland.org/) , and take in the exhibits at the[Whitney Museum of American Art](https://whitney.org/) .


## Carry The Experience Forward


[Technology & Innovation Forum East](https://www.forrester.com/event/technology-innovation-east/) delivers two days of insights, conversations, and perspectives designed to help technology leaders move forward with confidence. But when you look back, you may remember more than the sessions themselves: a conversation over coffee, a walk along the High Line, dinner with peers tackling similar challenges, or a new perspective gained between meetings.


That’s part of what makes New York such a fitting backdrop for the Forum. From Hudson Yards to the surrounding neighborhoods, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to recharge, connect, and make the most of your time beyond the agenda.


## Keep The Conversation Going


Follow the[Forrester Technology & Security Events LinkedIn page](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/forrester-technology-security-events/?trk=affiliated-pages) for event updates, analyst insights, practical takeaways, and what’s next.
